_readme: Sample products for the Tenshi CMS store widget's demo mode (copied from data/shop-demo.json of the marketing site's Shop demo). Pictures: img/*.webp next to this file. Same shape store.js builds from the Shopify Storefront API.

products.title: Neon Angel Tee
products.description: Heavyweight black cotton tee with the glowing 天 mark on the chest and TENSHI underneath. Soft-washed, unisex fit.
products.imageAlt: Black T-shirt with a glowing pink Tenshi 天 logo and the word TENSHI

products.title: Undercity Art Print
products.description: Museum-grade giclée print of the Undercity cover art: a neon city carved into the depths. Ships rolled in a tube; frame not included.
products.imageAlt: Framed print of the Undercity neon cavern city artwork

products.title: Synthwave Desk Mat
products.description: Extra-large 900 × 400 mm desk mat with the synthwave skyline from our homepage, stitched glowing-pink edges and a non-slip base.
products.imageAlt: Large desk mat printed with a neon synthwave city at sunset, pink stitched edge

products.title: Arcade Enamel Pin Set
products.description: Three hard-enamel pins with gold plating: the 天 mark, a PLAY button and a GG badge. Rubber backs, gift box included.
products.imageAlt: Three enamel pins: a red Tenshi logo pin, a purple play button pin and an orange GG pin

products.title: Launch Pack: 5-Page Website
products.description: A fast, mobile-first five-page website designed and built by Tenshi, with hosting set up, basic SEO and a contact form. Live in about two weeks.
products.imageAlt: Glowing card showing a website mock-up, a rocket and the words Launch Pack

products.title: Care Plan: Hosting & Updates
products.description: Managed hosting on our servers, security and plugin updates, nightly backups and small content changes each month.
products.imageAlt: Glowing card with a shield and heartbeat icon and the words Care Plan
